content.text: All renewal terms sit in § 8 and meet the preferred position in full.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: § 8.2–8.3 satisfy the preferred RENEWAL position: renewal is automatic in successive twelve-month terms (no multi-year renewal), Customer may opt out on thirty days' written notice (within the 30-day preferred window), Vendor must send a renewal reminder at least sixty days beforehand (with the opt-out deadline extended if it fails to do so), and renewal uplift on recurring Fees is capped at the lesser of CPI and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. No other clause (§ 7 Fees, § 9 Termination) contains a competing renewal or uplift mechanic. No redline needed.
